paper.claimed_sonic_scope: LoRA in actor dynamics decoder and critic; FSQ and other pretrained components frozen
paper.generic_s7_scope: actor backbone + actor proprioception input + actor output + critic backbone; ablated on Oli-WBT to Luna, not Sonic
paper.reported_full_budget: 8000 iterations; 4 A100 about 90 GPU-hours for Sonic-to-Oli real-world example

train: all Linear projections in SONIC g1 dynamics decoder via LoRA
all Linear projections in critic via LoRA

s7_incremental_ablation.reason: Figure 7 S7 is evidence from Oli-WBT to Luna and must not be silently substituted for the paper's Sonic-specific scope

data.train: only train_candidate motions that pass Silver or Gold, later expanded with an independently versioned official-X2 AMASS/PHUMA/BONES corpus
data.held_out_rule: never used for optimizer updates, threshold selection, early stopping or checkpoint selection
data.paper_comparable_optional: OMOMO/LAFAN official-X2 retarget if raw assets and licenses are later available
data.sentinels: legacy official B/D clips remain regression pressure tests, not the sole adaptation corpus

compute_ladder.gate: exact initialization/replay and frozen/trainable tensor audit
finite rollout/loss/gradient; every intended LoRA group receives gradient
cross-motion improvement on training diagnostics without held-out regression or semantic failure
at least two action classes improve on official physics gates across 3 seeds
trend remains upward/plateaus safely; frozen source abilities retained
only on high-compute platform after all earlier gates; checkpoint selected by held-out physical panel, not reward peak

controls: X2 from scratch or existing target specialist
